title: Hadith card

paras.en: رشوت دینے اور لینے والے پر اللہ تعالیٰ کی لعنت ہے۔
paras.ur: Allah’s curse is upon the one who gives a bribe and the one who takes it.
paras.ps: په هغه چا چې رشوت ورکوي او چې رشوت اخلي د الله تعالی لعنت دی.

sourceNote: A framed card in a floral border with a hadith on bribery attributed to Ibn Majah, printed on the page facing the contents. The floral border is not reproduced. The watermark and the phone-number strip are excluded.
